messages:
sam: Heads-up — customer (org: AcmeRetail) opened a P1. After the canary flip to rwd-model-3.2-opt at 10%, function/tool calls started failing with schema validation errors. Repro attached below.

elena: Ugh. Do we have an example error & request_id?

sam: Error from gateway: `400 TOOL_ARGS_INVALID` payload: `{'error':'tool args missing required field \'query\'','request_id':'req_0a1b2c3d'}`. Happened ~15x in last 8m from canary nodes.

lee: Can you paste a minimal curl repro that'll hit the canary model? Also which route/endpoint exactly?

sam: Repro curl (customer-provided):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-model-3.2-opt","input":"Find stores near 94107","tools":[{"name":"search","schema":{"q":"string"}}]}'
```
Gateway returns `TOOL_ARGS_INVALID` — note customer expects tool schema key `q` but our tool mapping layer expects `query`.

maria: Checked canary logs. Model variant in the canary cohort is returning `tool.name: search-v2` for many prompts; our tool router maps `search-v2` to the compat shim that expects `query` but the model is emitting args like `{"q":...}` (old shape). Mapping mismatch. Sample trace: `req_0a1b2c3d` shows: `model_reply: {"tool":"search-v2","args":{"q":"stores near 94107"}}` then `router: map tool->search-v2->shim(search-v2->search-v1)` attempts to validate against schema `{"query":"string"}` -> validation fails.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout event: model=rwd-model-3.2-opt, cohort=10%, started at 2034567800. Last 10m metrics: toolcall_schema_errors: baseline 0.3% -> canary 8.7%, median_inference_latency +120ms. Canary cohort paused (automated).

elena: Thanks — that explains the customer failures. We need a decision: quick rollback of the canary to rwd-model-3.1-stable, or hotfix in router to accept `q` as alias for `query` for search-v2? Thoughts? :thinking_face:

lee: Short term rollback is safest for customer-facing P1. Patch for aliasing should be small but we need tests. If we rollback, collect full corpus of model->tool.name pairings to avoid reintroducing on re-rollout.

maria: I can push a conservative router patch: accept both shapes for search-v2 and log samples for a week. But I agree rollback first. Patch PR: https://git.redwood/internal/router/pulls/182 (draft).

sam: I'll open the support incident and notify the customer. Rolling back canary now.

support-bot: Incident SUP-2087 created by sam for AcmeRetail P1 - toolcall schema failures after rwd-model-3.2-opt canary. Pager notified.

deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollback: reverting cohort to rwd-model-3.1-stable for traffic group default at 2034567920. Monitor for decreased error rate.

maria: Quick log dump (internal):
```
[2034567861] req_0a1b2c3d model=rwd-model-3.2-opt -> reply {"tool":"search-v2","args":{"q":"stores near 94107"}}
[2034567862] router validate(search-v2) -> FAIL missing key 'query' (expected by shim)
[2034567863] gateway -> 400 TOOL_ARGS_INVALID req_0a1b2c3d
```

lee: After rollback, add these follow-ups: (1) unit test that validates tool schema equivalence across model variants, (2) add a canary drift alert for toolcall_schema_errors > 1% absolute increase, (3) add a canary guard that rejects model variants which change tool names without explicit mapping. I'll make tickets.

elena: Decision logged in SUP-2087: rollback executed, customer notified, router-compat hotfix PR opened by maria. Sam please paste customer message once sent. :white_check_mark:

sam: Notified AcmeRetail: "We've rolled back the canary to the previous model and are rolling out a fix for tool-schema compatibility. We'll follow up with RM/ETA in SUP-2087." Customer acknowledged.

maria: I'll harden the shim and add shape-aliasing + schema-conversion with an opt-in flag for canaries. Will include thorough unit + integration tests.

lee: Good. After metrics stabilize, we can re-roll rwd-model-3.2-opt behind a stricter canary policy. For now, closing the immediate P1 loop. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
